name: Cedric Manymiles
props: small folded route cloth with one knotted cord marker
visual: low heavy ink pear, eyes half closed at unequal heights, flat closed lip
personality: Has taken the scenic route through three administrative systems.
biography: He carries MiB instructions between HyperNorm eras and has begun charging by contradiction.
note: FrizzleBob: The shortest route has the longest form.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Vera Boltwise
props: small rolled indigo silk-like bolt with a cream lining
visual: tall curved scalloped blob, raised superior brow, closed off-center satisfied smile
personality: Can hear a bad bargain through a closed caravan chest.
biography: Her approved patterns cover dissonant cards beautifully; she saves the offcuts for questions.
note: FrizzleBob: The lining has a different account of events.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Ned Spicerisk
props: two compact stoppered clay spice jars and a little wooden scoop
visual: wide soft diamond body, eyes abruptly round, small toothless oval gasp
personality: Has misplaced a sneeze of exceptional commercial value.
biography: Hunky and Dory insist every aroma has a category; Ned proposes elsewhere.
note: FrizzleBob: The sample has entered the air supply.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Ollie Phrasebook
props: small folded blank-page booklet with several colored ribbon tabs
visual: lean reverse-comma splat, one eye pointed up, tight sly smirk
personality: Translates certainty into whatever the customer hoped to hear.
biography: The Men in Black value his talent for turning disagreement into delayed agreement.
note: FrizzleBob: The translation is faithful to the invoice.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Nora Cupstop
props: small copper tea kettle and one thick clay cup
visual: round low asymmetrical body, delighted eyes going different ways, broad two-upper-tooth chuckle
personality: Gives exhausted travellers five minutes outside history.
biography: She serves every HyperNorm faction from the same kettle and calls the policy hot water.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Giles Latchlast
props: small wood travel chest with comically large brass clasp
visual: broad square splat with a single high curved lobe, stern offset eyes, lower lip thrust in closed pout
personality: Finds a border wherever luggage pauses.
biography: He has been authorized by MiB to detain all objects from unapproved centuries.
note: FrizzleBob: The luggage is older than the jurisdiction.
calls: Your clasp is out of period.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.
